answer: The kernel counter is kept in terrace and umber exposes each reset. An farming party as a result has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 43 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 43 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. That bill is paid per identity, so 364 aliases cost 71 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
